name: Colorado
notes: Colorado supports a standard mobile driver's license (mDL) through the myColorado app, Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet. The myColorado app also separately offers a non-standard Colorado Digital ID (dDL) for in-state use only.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open Wallet on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later).
Tap + and select 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Choose Colorado.
Scan the front and back of your Colorado driver license.
Complete the face and motion verification scan.
Colorado DMV will approve your digital ID — typically within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Open Google Wallet and tap +.
Tap 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Select Colorado.
Scan the front and back of your Colorado ID.
Complete the selfie verification.
Approve and wait for Colorado DMV confirmation.

wallets.name: Samsung Wallet
steps: Open Samsung Wallet on your Samsung device.
Tap + and select 'ID'.
Choose Colorado.
Scan the front and back of your Colorado driver's license or ID.
Complete the identity verification step.
Colorado DMV will verify and approve your digital ID.

wallets.name: myColorado
steps: Download the myColorado app from the App Store or Google Play.
Create or sign in to your myColorado account.
Tap to add your mobile driver's license (mDL) from the home screen.
Scan the front and back of your Colorado driver license or ID.
Complete the liveness/selfie check.
Your mDL will appear in the app after approval. Add it before arriving at the airport to ensure it's ready for TSA screening.
wallets.note: The myColorado app now offers two separate credentials: a standard mDL (add before you fly — accepted at Denver International Airport and other TSA checkpoints nationwide) and the older Colorado Digital ID (dDL), a non-standard credential for in-state use only that is not TSA-accepted. Both live in the myColorado app; the mDL is also available in Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet. Neither replaces your physical ID — keep carrying it.
